reviews.title: Years of Calendar Events Gone - Lost My Trust in PocketLife
reviews.text:
I’ve been using PocketLife for a few years, and I’ve always entered my events directly into the app not into another calendar that syncs with it. Recently, all of my events disappeared.

Support told me there’s no way for them to erase my events, but that doesn’t explain what happened. Since these events were entered directly into PocketLife, I’m concerned there may be a glitch or issue with the app.

I had appointments, meetings, and events scheduled for the next several months. Losing all of that information is incredibly upsetting, and “disappointed” is an understatement. I relied on this app for years, but I no longer feel confident trusting it with my schedule. I’ll be returning to my phone’s native calendar moving forward.

reviews.title: Keeps resetting my calendar
reviews.text: I have been using pocket life for almost 6 years.  This past year when I paid to renew my membership. I lost everything for the past five years.  Every event that I’ve logged notes history of appointments I tracked.  I submitted an inquiry through the support.  Never heard back.  I was physically sick from losing all of that information.  Had already paid for the year so I had started over.  I use this planner as a way to track my very busy schedule with myself and my children and my spouse.  Today I went to check to see what time an appointment was later this week. And my calendar has completely reset again.  Everything I had plugged for the entire year is now gone.  Every reappointment I have logged through the rest of the year is now gone.  I cannot describe the level of inconvenience this has created.  I will be looking for another app in the future. And do not recommend using PocketLife at all.  Whatever updates they implemented at the end of 2025 are faulty and undependable. The subscription fee for this app is not worth the trouble and missed appointments. It will create.  Do better developers.  And I have to spend the rest of the week contacting different offices. To check on appointments for my three children and myself for the rest of the year to make sure I do not miss anything last minute.

reviews.title: Joy
reviews.text:
I previously used PocketLife on an iPhone 13 Pro Max and purchased the full version of the app, including the additional event features bundled with the purchase. I recently upgraded to an iPhone 17 Pro Max and transferred all applications and data to the new device using Apple’s standard iOS data migration process.

After the transfer, PocketLife installed successfully; however, the app is not functioning correctly. I am experiencing the following issues:
	•	Inability to properly edit scheduled events
	•	Certain premium event features included with my original purchase do not function as expected
	•	Changes made within the app are either not saved or not applied correctly

This issue did not occur on my previous device and began only after migrating to the new iPhone. I would like to confirm whether this is a known compatibility issue related to the iPhone 17 Pro Max or the current iOS version, or if there are recommended steps to re-sync, reauthorize purchases, or restore app functionality.

Please let me know if you require additional details such as:
	•	iOS version
	•	PocketLife app version
	•	Screenshots or screen recordings
	•	Purchase verification information

Thank you for your time and assistance. I look forward to your guidance on resolving this issue.
